```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[very thick, line cap = round]
    \def\Lx{6}
    \def\Ly{0.8}
    \def\r{0.1}

    \draw[white,top color=white,bottom color=mygrey,shading angle=90] (0,-\Ly) rectangle (0.5*\Lx,\Ly);
    \draw (0.5*\Lx,\Ly) -- (0.5*\Lx,-\Ly) node[below] {$E_{\text{F}}$};
    \draw[->] (0,0) -- (\Lx,0) node[right] {$E$};

    \coordinate (h) at (0.4*\Lx,0.3*\Ly);
    \coordinate (e) at (0.57*\Lx,0.3*\Ly);
    \coordinate (e2) at (0.8*\Lx,0);

    \draw[mydashed] (e2) --++ (0,\Ly);

    \draw[black!45, fill=white] (h) circle (\r);
    \fill (e) circle (\r);
    \fill (e2) circle (\r);

    \draw[white, line width=1.9pt] ($(h)!0.57!(e)$) -- ($(h)!0.85!(e)$);
    \draw[->] ($(h)!0.1!(e)$) -- ($(h)!0.93!(e)$);

    \draw[->] ($(e2)+(0,-2*\r)$) to[bend left] ($(e2)+(-0.17*\Lx,-\r)$);
    \node[below] at ($(e2)+(-0.085*\Lx,-2*\r)$) {$\delta$};

    \draw[<->] (0.5*\Lx,\Ly) -- (0.8*\Lx,\Ly) node[pos=0.5,fill=white,inner sep=0] {$\Delta$};

\end{tikzpicture}
```
